mapper.sql: SELECT rel.id, rel.rel_id, rel.school_id, rel.supplier_id, sr.supplier_name, rel.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.goods_code, g.category_name, g.brand_name, g.main_image, g.detail_images_json, g.detail_content, g.sale_type, rel.status, g.status AS goods_status, g.publish_status, COALESCE(rel.update_by, rel.create_by) AS operate_by, COALESCE(rel.update_time, rel.create_time) AS operate_time, size_stat.group_min_price, size_stat.group_max_price, size_stat.stock_total, CASE WHEN size_stat.group_min_price IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN size_stat.group_min_price = size_stat.group_max_price THEN CAST(size_stat.group_min_price AS CHAR) ELSE CONCAT(CAST(size_stat.group_min_price AS CHAR), '-', CAST(size_stat.group_max_price AS CHAR)) END AS group_price_range FROM xfpt_school_supplier_goods_rel rel INNER JOIN xfpt_school_supplier_rel sr ON sr.id = rel.rel_id AND sr.school_id = rel.school_id AND sr.cooperate_status = '1' AND sr.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN xfpt_goods g ON g.id = rel.goods_id AND g.del_flag = 0 AND g.status = '1' AND g.publish_status = '1' AND g.sale_type IN ('1', '3') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MIN(group_price) AS group_min_price, MAX(group_price) AS group_max_price, SUM(stock_num) AS stock_total FROM xfpt_goods_size WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = '1' GROUP BY goods_id ) size_stat ON size_stat.goods_id = rel.goods_id
mapper.select:
WHERE rel.del_flag = 0
AND rel.status = #{status} AND g.goods_name LIKE concat('%', #{goodsName}, '%') AND g.goods_code LIKE concat('%', #{goodsCode}, '%') AND g.category_name LIKE concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%') AND sr.supplier_name LIKE concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%') ORDER BY COALESCE(rel.update_time, rel.create_time) DESC, rel.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE xfpt_school_supplier_goods_rel rel INNER JOIN xfpt_school_supplier_rel sr ON sr.id = rel.rel_id AND sr.school_id = rel.school_id AND sr.cooperate_status = '1' AND sr.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN xfpt_goods g ON g.id = rel.goods_id AND g.del_flag = 0 AND g.status = '1' AND g.publish_status = '1' AND g.sale_type IN ('1', '3') SET rel.status = #{status}, rel.update_by = #{updateBy}, rel.update_time = NOW() WHERE rel.id = #{id} AND rel.del_flag = 0
